newsitem.title: USA: SCB Computer sees earnings up on purchase.
newsitem.headline: SCB Computer sees earnings up on purchase.

text.p: SCB Computer Technology Inc said on Monday that it completed the acquisition of Partner's Resources Inc and Partner's Capital Group in a transaction it expects to be accretive to earnings in fiscal 1998.

Partner's Resources, an information technology outsourcing company, and Partner's Capital Group, a computer leasing business, had combined revenues of about $21 million in 1996, SCB said in a statement.
SCB did not disclose a purchase price, but said the transaction is being funded by cash on hand and borrowings under a credit line.
SCB provides information technolgy management and technical services.
